checks.name: A 400 m reflection lens retains the main optical settings without inheriting its 2300 m far projection
Ground-plane clipping remains finite at low clearance, changing heading, pitch and camera roll
Dedicated radial culling removes far meshes and far instanced batches while preserving near and already-hidden objects
A failed reflection pass restores dedicated visibility without reviving the generic hidden set
Connector pavements and fixtures share physics records and stay outside the entire canonical carriageway width
Authored frontage orders cover every route family and every facade retains outward-facing doorway fixtures
A near road fixture retains a slot when nearby door lights compete for the balanced budget

captureProtocol.baselineScope: Full untouched 3.9 checkout. User-supplied IAB frames prove real WebGL, but their displayed version alone does not verify commit or cache identity. Keep 1280x720 and 2031x1244 capture batches separate.
captureProtocol.stillConditions: Same camera position/target, 48 degree vertical FOV, full paused vehicle position/quaternion/wing/light state, 1280x720 drawing buffer, pixel ratio 1, quality and weather. Wait 3 s of rendered frames for light selection to settle. Lock 3.9 exposure (day .87, night 1.02). Save source build, actual light IDs/gains, vehicle state, exposure, reflection time/position with the same PNG. A changed lighting preset is a separate comparison.
captureProtocol.timingConditions: Record observed browser/renderer (unknown stays unknown), resolution and quality. Separate paused 30 Hz refresh, loading/5 s warmup and 150 s driven steady capture. Actual route inputs/trajectory accompany p50/p95/p99 and long frames. A point HUD FPS is not a route benchmark.
captureProtocol.acceptance: Requires actual WebGL images and measured display/GPU timing. Scene graph, shader and DOM checks are separate structural evidence.
captureProtocol.reason: User-supplied 3.9 IAB WebGL images were inspected separately. These Node checks have no graphics driver and do not provide 3.10 after-images or route frame times.

limits: CPU geometry, matrix, shared world and renderer-state contracts only. None establish real image quality, shadow leakage, frame times or steering feel.
Reflection distance culling is conservative per mesh/instanced batch. A sphere crossing 400 m is retained; the rebuilt bounded base projection then receives an oblique near plane.

The original city and physical corridor remain. Daytime diffuse was rebaked for the current envelopes and a stationary one-bounce night field was added; fine facade details remain an averaged-envelope approximation.
